lead: The page around a sign-in (or sign-up) form, in three looks for the same parts: a card in the middle, a cover beside the form, or the card over a full-page background. The brand, the title and the form are yours, this places them; the glow and the dividers come from the theme style.

providers.title: Other ways in and a toolbar

demo.title: Sign in
demo.footer: Don't have an account? Create one
demo.coverText: Components, themes and an admin shell, ready to use

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.cover: `split`: the left side: the brand over the glow, and `cover-body` in the middle for the `cover` slot
styling.glow: A soft glow of the primary color: the split cover's and the cover variant's background
styling.backdrop: `cover`: the full-page background, a glow or the `backgroundImage`
styling.main: The form's side: the toolbar (top right), the panel and, in `centered` and `cover`, the card around it
styling.head: The brand, the title and the line under it
styling.providers: The other ways in: a divider with its text and the buttons
styling.height: `--ui-login-min-height` sets how tall the page is (the viewport's by default); the examples above set it to show the page in a box.
